description: Defines the GraphTask class and related structures for managing autograd backward graph execution in PyTorch, including metadata, execution info, error handling, and stream management.

classes.name: GraphTask
classes.description: Manages metadata and execution state for a single backward pass in autograd, including task tracking, error handling, and stream management.

classes.name: GraphTask::ExecInfo
classes.description: Contains execution filtering info for nodes during autograd backward.

classes.name: GraphTask::ExecInfo::Capture
classes.description: Represents captured variables and hooks for autograd nodes.

classes.name: GraphTaskGuard
classes.description: RAII guard to set and restore the current GraphTask context.

methods.name: stash_current_streams
methods.description: Stores current device streams for later synchronization.

methods.name: init_to_execute
methods.description: Initializes the GraphTask with root node, outputs, and other parameters for execution.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Checks if the GraphTask has finished execution.

methods.name: mark_as_completed_and_run_post_processing
methods.description: Marks the GraphTask as completed and triggers post-processing steps.

methods.name: set_exception
methods.description: Sets an exception on the GraphTask when an error occurs during execution.

methods.name: set_exception_without_signal
methods.description: Sets an exception without marking the task as completed, allowing manual control.
